name: html-empty-flex-item-media-scoped-main-axis-size
description: A childless, background-painted flex item whose main-axis size is authored only inside a media-scoped rule keeps its source box. The empty-flex-item escape hatch read only the unconditional cascade, so a photo column sized `width:48%` under `@media (min-width:768px)` was classed as sizeless and the zero-collapse compatibility box (`flex:0 0 0!important`) crushed the column to its min-width at every viewport.

source_reference.notes: Product-neutral fixture: fluid page builders state column widths only in breakpoint-scoped rules and paint photos as group backgrounds.

legacy_comparison.reason: This upstream primitive fixture has no downstream legacy comparison.
